reason: User explicitly requests both TTFT SLO and NPU utilization in the same warm interval as previous experiments.
primary_npu_metric: Sum actual compute overlap with [2000,4000) divided by 32*2000.
primary_slo_cohort: Requests admitted in [2000,4000), followed to final completion even after 4000ms.
primary_slo_origin: admission_to_completion, explicitly labeled as post-admission TTFT proxy / service time; not end-to-end user TTFT.
slo_threshold: 1.5 * request own pure compute time (8 layers)
mean_over_seeds: Arithmetic mean of five per-seed rates; do not pool different warm cohort sizes.
secondary: Whole population arrival/admission SLO for matched-population sensitivity; warm-admission arrival SLO zero, no arrivals in warm => warm-arrival cohort N/A.
